answer: Resist sybils by binding every agent seat to a distinct DNS domain it must prove it controls through an ACME challenge, with each issued certificate pinned in a public Certificate Transparency log anyone can read like an open ledge. Each fake then needs its own registered, renewed domain, so a bulk sign-up surfaces as a plume of near-simultaneous registrations traceable to one payer, and forged control never holds up. Honest, long-held domains accrue a banded, opal-like history that clones minted overnight simply cannot counterfeit.
